					}
					AND = {
						glorpui_svh_policy_core = { KEY = two_treatises_of_government_policy LAW = legitimization_of_power_law }
						OR = {
							has_advance = legitimization_of_power_law_advance
							AND = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation } government_type = government_type:monarchy }
						}
						policy:two_treatises_of_government_policy = { NOT = { is_locked_for = PREV } }
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_policy = dop_favor_the_commoners }
						glorpui_svh_policy_core = { KEY = dop_traditional_distribution_of_power LAW = distribution_of_power_law }
						policy:dop_traditional_distribution_of_power = { NOT = { is_locked_for = PREV } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}

glorpui_svh_visible_jurisprudence = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:glorpui_sv = societal_value_type:mysticism_vs_jurisprudence
			scope:glorpui_country = {
				has_societal_value = societal_value_type:mysticism_vs_jurisprudence
				OR = {
					AND = {
						country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
						glorpui_svh_privilege_takeable = { KEY = autonomous_kadiluks }
					}
					AND = {
						country_has_estate = estate_type:dhimmi_estate
						glorpui_svh_privilege_takeable = { KEY = dhimmi_land_rights }
					}
					AND = {
						country_has_estate = estate_type:dhimmi_estate
						glorpui_svh_privilege_takeable = { KEY = dhimmi_mazalim_court }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}

glorpui_svh_visible_hellenization = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:glorpui_sv = societal_value_type:latinization_vs_hellenization
			scope:glorpui_country = {
				has_societal_value = societal_value_type:latinization_vs_hellenization
				OR = {
					AND = {
						glorpui_svh_reform_core = { KEY = theme_system }
						government_reform:theme_system = { NOT = { is_locked_for = PREV } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}
